# Check coverage

<!-- Generated by `python3 checks/design-catalog-validate.py --write-coverage` from the
     COVERAGE declaration in each check script. Do not edit this file by hand. -->

What each check decides, and what it leaves to a person. A control that a
check covers in part still needs a manual pass for what it misses. How to run
each check, and how it works inside, is in [README.md](README.md).

## Rule checks

### `component-manifest.py`

Also validates `.dx/component-manifest.json` against its spec.

| Control | Tier | Covers | Misses |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CMP-1 | L1 | With `coverage: "complete"` in the manifest, a component import in changed source that resolves outside the manifest | Every import when the manifest's coverage is partial or absent. A barrel re-export can give a false hit |

### `rendered-check.py`

Runs axe on a page that is already open, at 360 and 1280 in each supported theme, plus one reduced-motion cell. With no open session, every control below goes to manual verification. It clicks nothing, so anything behind an interaction stays manual.

| Control | Tier | Covers | Misses |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A11Y-1 | Removed | axe `color-contrast` in both themes | Items axe reports as incomplete, such as text over a background image or a gradient |
| A11Y-3 | Removed | axe `label` | Labels on controls behind an interaction |
| A11Y-4 | Removed | axe `target-size`, enabled by name, at 360 and 1280 | Targets behind an interaction |
| A11Y-5 | Removed | What still moves under reduced-motion emulation, in one cell at 1280 | Whether an animation is essential, which is judgment |
| A11Y-6 | Removed | axe `image-alt` and `svg-img-alt` | Whether an image is informative or decorative |
| A11Y-7 | Removed | axe `list`, `listitem`, and `heading-order` | Whether a heading is descriptive |
| A11Y-8 | Removed | The axe aria suite from the installed axe, on markup a person can reach | Closed overlays, state changes, and hidden markup, which go to the manual pass |
| A11Y-9 | Removed | axe `document-title` and `html-has-lang` | Whether a single-page app updates its title for each view |
| A11Y-10 | Removed | axe `bypass`, report-only: it never fails the run | Whether the skip link comes first |

### `token-audit.py`

| Control | Tier | Covers | Misses |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TOK-1 | L1 | Raw hex, rgb, hsl, oklch, and named colours in style contexts, and raw colour inside Tailwind arbitrary-value utilities such as `bg-[…]` | None recorded |
| TOK-2 | L1 | Off-scale spacing against the shadcn default scale | None recorded |
| TOK-3 | L1 | Off-scale border-radius, and concentric nesting on one element | Peer-radius consistency across elements, which is judgment |
| COL-1 | L1 | Palette bypass only: a Tailwind palette class that skips the semantic layer | Whether a primary action uses the product primary, which is judgment |
| COL-2 | L1 | Tailwind palette utility classes that bypass the semantic layer, except colour names the theme defines | None recorded |

### `type-scan.py`

| Control | Tier | Covers | Misses |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TYP-1 | L1 | A font family other than Plus Jakarta Sans and Inter, `font-mono` and `font-serif`, and a non-approved generic as the primary family | Font weights |
| TYP-3 | L1 | Sizes off the Tailwind default type scale, read from TYP-3's catalogue entry | Sizes set in a stylesheet the scan cannot see, or composed from variables |

## Covered by no check

No check decides these controls. Verify each one by hand against its
detail file.

| Control | Tier | Check type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CNT-14 | L2 | judgment |
| IDN-1 | L1 | hybrid |
| IDN-2 | L1 | hybrid |
| IDN-3 | L2 | judgment |
| IDN-4 | L1 | judgment |

## Process checks

These checks validate records, the harness, or other checks. They decide
no control.

- `audit-record.py`: Checks that each decision record in `docs/decisions/` follows the design loop and its template.
- `detect.py`: Runs the other checks as one entry point, with one exit contract and an ignore layer. It decides no control itself.
- `reaudit-scope.py`: Lists the decision records to re-audit when a control is added or changed. A query, not a gate.
- `skill-audit.py`: Reports a file in a skill's `references/` folder that nothing in that skill names.
- `skill-locators.py`: Checks that every `../../../` path in the skill docs resolves to a file.
- `waiver-reconcile.py`: Reconciles each `dx-waive` waiver in source with its row in a decision record's waivers table.
